Body.Content:
We're excited to launch Azure Reserved Virtual Machine Instances, which will allow you to reserve virtual machines at extremely low prices on Azure. With Reserved Virtual Machine Instances, receive savings up to 82 percent lower than pay-as-you-go prices with Azure Hybrid Use Benefit, and up to 72 percent savings for all virtual machines. Azure Reserved Virtual Machine Instances are flexible and easy to exchange or cancel as business needs evolve. It's also simple to purchase Reserved Virtual Machine Instances in few easy steps.

Learn more about Azure Reserved Virtual Machine Instances.

Learn about cost savings with Reserved Virtual Machine Instances.
